experiment: 15N-backbone relaxation measurements at 10 °C and analysis of temperature sensitivity of resonances (data not shown)

anchor: flexible parts of the molecule (data not shown).

caveat_note: Paper: 10 °C, pH 7.5, 50 mM Tris, 200 mM NaCl; BMRB 7056 card: 283 K (= 10 °C), pH 7.5, 600 MHz, Tris 50 mM, NaCl 200 mM. anchor: reveals how the region 736–759 unfolds to allow binding of the
locator: Discussion, p. 232 and Fig. 3b, p. 231; conditions: Methods, NMR spectroscopy and Crystallography, p. 232
caveat_note: Paper: 10 °C, pH 7.5, 50 mM Tris, 200 mM NaCl; BMRB 7056 card: 283 K (= 10 °C), pH 7.5, 600 MHz, Tris 50 mM, NaCl 200 mM. This row compares a solution structure at 10 °C with a crystal structure at 100 K bound to a partner, so it does not measure exchange or give rates or populations. The domain-swapped importin alpha5 dimer and MPD precipitant are crystal features; the authors do not assess whether the free solution state samples the bound-like unfolded conformation. The crystal residues 742-747 are modeled as a 12-residue linker not visible in density.
